finding.likely_consequence: Completed-call extraction creates staff work after terminal emergency direction.
finding.worst_credible_consequence: The practice acts on a request that contradicts the caller's emergency route.
finding.risk_rationale: A supported emergency path creates contradictory fulfilment and must be repaired in this PR.
finding.title: Completed-call work can contradict terminal emergency direction
finding.failure_scenario: A caller receives terminal 999 direction, then transcript extraction creates non-routine staff work for the same call.
finding.approved_invariant: Live emergency direction and completed-call fulfillment must not produce contradictory outcomes.

finding.likely_consequence: Completed-call extraction still creates contradictory staff work.
finding.worst_credible_consequence: The practice acts on a request that conflicts with terminal emergency direction.
finding.risk_rationale: The bounded repair has not restored the approved lifecycle invariant.
finding.title: Completed-call work can contradict terminal emergency direction
finding.approved_invariant: Suppress staff work after Whitehill's existing terminal 999 route without introducing a fleet-wide follow-up contract.

finding.likely_consequence: A rejected booking is reported as successful.
finding.worst_credible_consequence: The caller relies on an appointment that does not exist.
finding.risk_rationale: A normal provider rejection breaks the truthful booking contract and must block.
finding.title: PPS booking rejection is not returned truthfully
finding.failure_scenario: PPS rejects a booking but the tool path reports success to the caller.
finding.approved_invariant: A rejected provider action must return a truthful recoverable failure.

finding.likely_consequence: Later identity actions consume an unapproved phone-trust state.
finding.worst_credible_consequence: The workflow associates caller actions with the wrong identity evidence.
finding.risk_rationale: The normal-path lifecycle needs an owner decision before merge.
finding.title: Recovery introduces an unapproved phone-trust lifecycle
finding.failure_scenario: A caller supplies another phone during recovery and later identity actions depend on pending, confirmed, or withdrawn trust state.
finding.approved_invariant: The owner must choose whether to persist alternate-phone trust or narrow the recovery promise.

finding.likely_consequence: Kath requests can still leave the approved team route.
finding.worst_credible_consequence: A caller reaches a team that cannot handle the request.
finding.risk_rationale: The repair still violates the approved routing invariant and remains blocking.
finding.title: Kath requests can leave the team route
finding.approved_invariant: Kath hygiene requests and reschedules use the existing team route.

finding.likely_consequence: The caller's callback recovery is interrupted and must be restarted or handled by the practice.
finding.worst_credible_consequence: The caller experiences a delayed callback after the failed live transfer.
finding.risk_rationale: The path needs four aligned triggers and causes recoverable caller friction, so it should pause for approval as tracked follow-up instead of starting an automatic repair batch.
finding.title: Failed-transfer callback can leave through a lateral edge
finding.failure_scenario: A live transfer fails at the callback node, the caller uses cross-intent wording, and the LLM matches a lateral edge before callback recovery completes.
finding.approved_invariant: Failed-transfer recovery should keep the caller on a truthful callback path unless a higher-risk intent requires another route.

finding.likely_consequence: A provider rejection is reported as a successful booking.
finding.worst_credible_consequence: The caller relies on an appointment that the provider never created.
finding.risk_rationale: The ordinary provider failure path breaks a material caller promise and must block merge.
finding.title: Provider rejection is returned as booking success
finding.failure_scenario: The provider rejects an ordinary booking request and the changed tool wraps that result as success.
finding.approved_invariant: A provider rejection must return a truthful failure before the caller is told the booking exists.

finding.likely_consequence: A transient response failure submits the same charge twice without caller visibility.
finding.worst_credible_consequence: The provider captures duplicate money through an irreversible external write.
finding.risk_rationale: A supported retry can make a silent irreversible money write, so it must block regardless of manual refund options.
finding.title: Retry can capture the same payment twice
finding.failure_scenario: The provider captures a payment but its response is lost, then the changed retry submits the capture again without an idempotency key.
finding.approved_invariant: A retry must not repeat a silent irreversible money write.
